content:
We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see signals for methyl groups (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see number of distinct methyl carbons. Probably easiest: get proton NMR spectra via tool. Then count peaks corresponding to CH3 (typically around 0.9 ppm for aliphatic, maybe 2-3 for aromatic methyl). But need to interpret.

We can request proton_nmr_spectra.
